# AL JUDE Travel & Tourism
# judextravel.com | Amman, Jordan
# Last updated: May 2026

## Who We Are
AL JUDE Travel & Tourism (الجود للسياحة والسفر) is a full-service travel agency based in Amman, Jordan. We have over 15 years of experience in tourism, specializing in international packages, charter flights, Umrah, and aircraft leasing. We serve travelers from Jordan and the broader Arab region.

## What We Do
We offer end-to-end travel services including:
- Complete tourism packages (hotel + transport + flight ticket)
- Hotels and transportation only (for travelers with their own tickets)
- Charter flights from Amman (Marka Airport and Queen Alia International)
- Umrah packages (Royal Jordanian and luxury bus)
- Aircraft leasing: Charter, ACMI, Dry Lease, Group flights, Medical evacuation
- Special offers and seasonal deals (Eid, summer, school holidays)

## Destinations We Cover (13 destinations)
Turkey: Istanbul (43 hotels), Trabzon (10 hotels), Antalya (20 hotels)
Egypt: Sharm El-Sheikh (91 hotels)
Jordan: Aqaba (32 hotels, weekday/weekend JOD pricing)
Georgia: Batumi, Tbilisi, combined programs (7 packages, ticket included)
Southeast Asia: Malaysia, Bali, Singapore, Vietnam, Thailand, Maldives, Sri Lanka

## Pricing Structure
All selling prices in Jordanian Dinar (JOD). Five pricing types:
- Type 1: Per person per night x nights + ticket + transport + profit (Sharm, Antalya)
- Type 2: Room price / persons x nights + transport + profit (Aqaba, Umrah)
- Type 3: Per person per bundled package nights + ticket + profit (Istanbul, Trabzon)
- Type 4: DMC full program + international ticket + profit (Malaysia, Bali, Singapore, Vietnam, Thailand, Maldives, Sri Lanka)
- Type 5: DMC all-inclusive price (ticket included) + profit only (Georgia)

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: How do I book a package with AL JUDE?
A: Contact us via WhatsApp at +962 6 461 0666. We respond within minutes during business hours and 24/7 on WhatsApp.

Q: What destinations does AL JUDE Travel cover from Amman Jordan?
A: We cover 13 destinations: Istanbul, Trabzon, Antalya (Turkey), Sharm El-Sheikh (Egypt), Aqaba (Jordan), Georgia (Batumi & Tbilisi), Malaysia, Bali Indonesia, Singapore, Vietnam, Thailand, Maldives, and Sri Lanka.

Q: Do AL JUDE packages include flight tickets?
A: Yes. Our packages.html page includes hotel + transport + round-trip flight. Our hotels-transport.html page offers hotel and transport only for travelers who already have their tickets.

Q: Does AL JUDE offer Umrah packages from Jordan?
A: Yes. We offer Umrah packages by Royal Jordanian and luxury bus with 4-star and 5-star hotels near the Grand Mosque in Mecca and the Prophet's Mosque in Medina.

Q: Does AL JUDE arrange charter flights from Amman?
A: Yes. We operate charter flights from Marka Airport and Queen Alia International to Istanbul, Sharm El-Sheikh, Antalya, Trabzon and other destinations.

Q: Does AL JUDE offer aircraft leasing?
A: Yes. We offer Charter, ACMI, Dry Lease, Group flights, and Medical evacuation services for corporations, airlines, and individuals.

Q: What are the cheapest packages from AL JUDE Travel?
A: Aqaba packages start from 99 JOD, Sharm El-Sheikh from 280 JOD, Istanbul from 350 JOD, Antalya from 400 JOD, Bali from 225 JOD per person.
